g.text: Left: a Telraam sensor counts only in daylight, so its daily total covers 9 hours in December and 16 in June; the fixed window covers the same 8 hours all year.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Right: the loop counts day and night; June has no complete day in the hourly release (July 26, 2025 to May 11, 2026; released June 4, 2026).
